items.q: Jimmy Mundy. Yeah. I know those names.

ctx.x: He had the band at the Lincoln Colonnade that I understand that in his band – I’ve actually seen pictures – John Malachi was in that band, Tommy Myles’s band. Tommy Potter was in that band. I’m trying to think of the arranger – Jimmy Mundy was also . . .
Jimmy Mundy. Yeah. I know those names.
